essence: The mantra should be written with red pigment by a concentrated practitioner.
The yantra should be drawn at twilight by a concentrated practitioner.
The ritual timing is specified when the moon is in Leo and the sun is in Cancer.
After writing it, the practitioner should wear it while facing north.
One who draws the yantra at night attains unwavering success.
